faqs.question: Can the CTFA unit operate in rooms without central HVAC?
faqs.answer: Yes! The CTFA unit is specifically designed to function either as a standalone wall-mounted fresh air unit or integrated into existing ductwork.

faqs.question: How often do the HEPA filters need replacement?
faqs.answer: Under standard commercial usage (10-12 hours daily), the primary HEPA filter lasts 12 months. Built-in pressure sensors alert facility staff when replacement is due.

items.overview: Nature purifies mountain, forest, and post-rain ocean air through a natural balance of positive and negative ions. The Active Bipolar Ionisation System replicates nature’s air purification model using Needlepoint Plasma Ionization technology. By releasing millions of balanced positive (H+) and negative (O2-) ions into the room, it actively neutralizes airborne viruses, bacteria, VOCs, and mold throughout 100% of the breathing zone.

faqs.question: Why is Plasma Ionization described as '180 degrees opposite' to traditional purifiers?
faqs.answer: Traditional purifiers are passive—air must be sucked into a physical box to be filtered. Bipolar Ionisation is active—it floods the living space with natural ions to kill pathogens right where you breathe.

faqs.question: Can this system be installed into existing central HVAC ductwork?
faqs.answer: Yes, IntelliGreen ionisation units integrate seamlessly into AHUs, ductwork, FCUs, or VRF systems to turn your existing HVAC into a central air purifier.

items.overview: Introducing untreated outdoor air in extreme Indian summers or winters forces air conditioning chillers to work overtime. The IntelliGreen Cross-Flow ERV (Energy Recovery Ventilator) solves the energy-vs-ventilation dilemma. Its internal diamond enthalpy core pre-cools and dehumidifies incoming hot outdoor air using the coolness of outgoing stale exhaust air—delivering 100% filtered fresh air while recovering up to 78% of thermal energy.
applications: Green Building Certified Corporate Campuses (IGBC / LEED / WELL)
High-Occupancy Conference Halls, Classrooms & Co-Working Floors
Luxury Villas, High-Rise Apartments & Boutique Hotels

faqs.question: Does exhaust air mix with the fresh incoming air inside the ERV core?
faqs.answer: Zero mixing occurs. The cross-flow enthalpy core consists of sealed alternating plates that transfer only thermal energy and water vapor molecules across a selective membrane while keeping exhaust pollutants 100% isolated.

items.overview: The EAC Electronic Air Cleaner relies on fundamental principles of Electrostatic Precipitation to deliver high-capacity micro-particle collection without restricting HVAC airflow. Engineered with a dual-stage setup featuring an initial Charging Section and a subsequent Collector Section, airborne particles are positively charged and attracted to oppositely charged collection plates. Officially GreenPro certified by CII–IGBC.

workingMechanism.title: Charging Section (Ionizing Stage)
workingMechanism.description: Airborne contaminants pass through high-voltage ionizing wires, imparting a positive electrical charge to fine dust, pollen, bacteria, and smoke particles.

workingMechanism.title: Collector Section (Electrostatic Capture)
workingMechanism.description: Charged particles enter an intense electrostatic field between oppositely charged aluminum collection plates, trapping micro-pollutants down to 0.01 microns.

workingMechanism.title: Low Resistance Airflow Circulation
workingMechanism.description: Purified air passes through with minimal static pressure drop (<25 Pa), maintaining optimum HVAC energy efficiency with zero disposable filter waste.

technicalSpecifications.Environmental Certification: GreenPro Certified by CII–IGBC (Indian Green Building Council)
technicalSpecifications.Maintenance: Washable Aluminum Collector Cells (15+ Year Lifespan)

faqs.question: What is GreenPro Certification by CII-IGBC?
faqs.answer: GreenPro certification by CII–IGBC validates that the EAC filter meets stringent green building performance criteria, earning direct credits toward IGBC and LEED ratings.
